title: DateRangePicker
description: Fiori date range picker: a start - end field with a range-selecting calendar.

usage.summary: Enter a localized Gregorian start and end date as one interval.
useWhen: Let users choose a contiguous date interval such as a booking or reporting period.
Allow direct typing or selection of the start and end in the calendar.
Set formatPattern, delimiter, minDate and maxDate to match the valid interval format and bounds.

avoidWhen.when: Enter a date together with a time rather than a date interval.
Keep a calendar visible or select separate, non-contiguous days.
Enter plain text without date or time parsing, or compose a custom picker with caller-owned value rules.
